name.en: Police 122 and the nearest police station

when.bs: Kad se prevara upravo događa, npr. neko dolazi po novac ili vam prijeti, nazovite 122. Za prijavu prevare ili pokušaja prevare javite se najbližoj policijskoj stanici ili upravi policije. Ponesite poruke, brojeve s kojih su stigle, snimke ekrana, linkove i potvrde o uplati.
when.en: When the fraud is happening right now, for example someone is coming to collect money or is threatening you, call 122. To report a fraud or attempted fraud, go to the nearest police station or police administration. Bring the messages, the numbers they came from, screenshots, links and payment receipts.

when.bs: Odmah ako ste upisali podatke kartice, PIN, CVC ili jednokratni kod, prijavili se preko linka iz poruke, dali nekome daljinski pristup ili uplatili novac prevarantu: tražite blokadu kartice i pristupa i osporavanje transakcija. Zovite samo broj sa poleđine kartice, iz aplikacije ili sa službene stranice banke, nikad broj iz poruke ni dugme za povratni poziv.
when.en: Straight away if you entered card details, a PIN, CVC or one-time code, logged in through a link from a message, gave someone remote access or paid a scammer: ask for your card and access to be blocked and the transactions disputed. Only call the number on the back of your card, in the app or on the bank’s official website, never a number from the message or the call-back button.

label.bs: Broj sa poleđine kartice ili iz aplikacije banke
label.en: The number on the back of your card or in your bank’s app

when.bs: Ako vas na OLX.ba kontaktira sumnjiv kupac, ako vam se neko na Viberu predstavlja kao OLX podrška ili ako želite provjeriti da li razgovarate s prevarantom. Prava podrška se javlja samo telefonom ili preko kontakt forme, nikad na Viber. Ne zamjenjuje prijavu policiji ni poziv banci.
when.en: If a suspicious buyer contacts you on OLX.ba, if someone on Viber claims to be OLX support, or if you want to check whether you are talking to a scammer. Real support is reached only by phone or the contact form, never on Viber. It does not replace a police report or a call to your bank.
